mobbin:a01989c0-b8a9-46af-9dea-dec74d6f7.summary: From the lock screen, the user monitors an in-progress audio recording Live Activity (waveform + elapsed time) and ends it with a single stop/done control—no unlock required.
steps: Lock-screen Live Activity — waveform + 0:19 + stop square
Lock-screen Live Activity — waveform + 0:22 + checkmark done
steal: Glanceable recording state without unlocking: live waveform + elapsed timer on the lock screen (both steps).
Single primary end-recording control on the Live Activity (stop square → checkmark); no secondary chrome (steps 1–2).
Control stays hit-target large beside the waveform so one-handed stop works while pocketed/gloved (step 1).
avoid: No pause on the Live Activity (both steps)—only stop/done; pocket tap can discard mid-thought with no resume.
mobbin:a01989c0-b8a9-46af-9dea-dec74d6f7.fit: Mobile uniquely owns lock-screen recording control; steal for Baseline remote start/stop / Live Activity indicator—phone as glanceable REC state while faculty moves rooms (not a desktop/SRV substitute).

mobbin:8d896cd3-c8c4-4b58-b852-317e91eec.summary: From a journal entry the user opens an audio recorder sheet, starts/pauses/resumes with waveform + ms timer, finishes with Done, and lands back on the entry with an attached audio player card—no on-screen transcript of the recording appears.
steps: Entry editor — media toolbar with waveform record icon
Bottom sheet — Start Audio Recording + red record @ 0:00
Full recorder idle — empty waveform, play/±15s, Done disabled
Recording — scrolling waveform, pause pill, Done dimmed
Paused — RESUME + enabled Done + scrub/play of take
Entry with audio card (play + 0:17 + quote icon) above body text
steal: Record starts as a bottom sheet over the note so context stays visible (step 2).
Paused state enables Done and lets you scrub/play the take before committing (step 5).
Done stays disabled until pause/stop so you cannot finalize mid-record (steps 3–4).
Finished take collapses to a compact player card on the note (step 6).
avoid: Quote/transcript icon appears on recorder and card (steps 3–6) but no transcript UI is shown—don't imply STT from these screens alone.
mobbin:8d896cd3-c8c4-4b58-b852-317e91eec.fit: Phone-side dictate-and-attach for Baseline timestamped voice notes while walking the room; extends TouchPro with pause/scrub-before-save—not room AV start/stop.
